{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS254 |prevtitle=A Royal Rumble with Regirock, Regice and Registeel II |nextcode=PS256 |nexttitle=With a Spoink in Your Step II |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=With a Spoink in Your Step I |subtitle=Legendary Island |title_ja=VS バネブー I |title_ro=VS Baneboo I |image=PS255.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 255 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|21}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 255 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|21}} |location={{gdis|Mirage Island|III}} }} '''With a Spoink in Your Step I''' (Japanese: '''VS バネブー I''' ''VS {{tt|Baneboo|Spoink}} I''), titled '''VS Spoink I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 255th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 75th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Legendary Island''' (Japanese: '''幻の島''' ''{{tt|Phantom|Mirage}} Island'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Mirage Island''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Confused, {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} ask the people that approached them who they are and where they are. The older man reveals himself to be [[Juan]], the {{ci|Sootopolis}} [[Gym Leader]] after having taking the position back from his student, [[Wallace]]. Juan reveals that they are on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}, an island isolated from the rest of [[Hoenn]]. With the help of his {{p|Kingdra}}, Juan shows the two what is happening in the outside world. Outside, {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} are still fighting each other. Juan reveals that when Ruby and Sapphire used the grand meteor on Groudon and Kyogre, it managed to free the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s from [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]], but sent the two young Trainers flying away in the process. Because of this, Groudon and Kyogre are now evenly matched, but the power that is released from their battle continues to accumulate and is erupting throughout Hoenn. Juan reassures the two by stating that even though the disaster that happened to Hoenn is happening once more, there are people currently fighting to contain the power. Juan reveals that {{Steven}}, [[Wallace]], [[Sidney]], [[Phoebe]], [[Glacia]], and [[Drake]] are all controlling the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}} in order to suppress the power emitted by Groudon and Kyogre. Even though they can delay the power Groudon and Kyogre release, Juan states that it is Ruby and Sapphire who will have to be the final opponents of the Legendary Pokémon. Juan states that in order to prepare for this moment, he, [[Tate and Liza|Tate, and Liza]] will have to train Ruby and Sapphire. Juan has Tate and Liza attack Ruby and Sapphire, forcing them to defend themselves by dodging their {{p|Spoink}}'s attacks. Ruby has {{p|Castform|Fofo}} attack Juan with {{m|Weather Ball}}, but Juan easily blocks the attack. This convinces Ruby to trust Juan, as he moves just like his master, Wallace. Deciding that Juan is now his grand master, Ruby gladly accepts the training offer. Juan is pleased with the answer, and tells the two that they will first train in the art of [[Double Battle]] with [[Tate and Liza]], the [[Mossdeep Gym]] Leaders. Juan states that they do not have much time to train, as the passage of time on Mirage Island is different than normal. Although Ruby and Sapphire were asleep for three days, in the outside world it was multiplied by seven, making it 21 days. Tate stops Juan from going any further, as Liza has sensed the presence of someone else on the island. As they try and find out what the presence is, the {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}} from before watch from afar. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} learn that they awoke on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}. * {{Steven}}, [[Wallace]], and the [[Hoenn]] [[Elite Four]] try to contain the power erupting from {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. * [[Tate and Liza]] begin training Ruby and Sapphire. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * [[Tate and Liza]] * [[Juan]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Sidney]] * [[Phoebe]] * [[Glacia]] * [[Drake]] * [[Steven Stone]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo]]/{{tt|Popo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Lairon}} ([[Rono]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Spoink}} ([[Tate and Liza]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Kingdra}} ([[Juan]]'s) * {{p|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) * {{p|Plusle}} ([[Ruby's Plusle|Adventures]]) * {{p|Minun}} ([[Sapphire's Minun|Adventures]]) * {{p|Regirock}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Adventures]]) * {{p|Regice}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Adventures]]) * {{p|Registeel}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Adventures]]) ==Trivia== * This chapter's [[VIZ Media]] name comes from the phrase "''A spring in your step''". ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 跳跳豬 I|VS Spoink I}} (Taiwan)
